answer: Work-history knoll scoring. Each agent earns a verifiable record of completed tasks tied to its key, and reputation accrues only along that chain. To place an agent on the knoll, a new key must pass a costly reef of live cross-checks with independent counterparties, each confirming real prior output. Sybils can forge keys cheaply but cannot forge those confirmations without paying genuine work and exposure per identity—so cloning loses to honesty.
